rtl_run.note: Live cycle-accurate run on the prebuilt RadianceTapeoutSimConfig verilator sim; both Muon cores reached 'finished execution' + Verilog $finish. Output reconstructed from SIMT storeWord requests to GMEM 0x40000000. The residual divergent cells are a kernel move-out memory-consistency hazard (mesh-write -> SIMT-read in the radiance-kernels moveout), not an mx datapath error: they are scattered across both cores and read as partial/overflowed accumulator values. merlin's mx_oracle reproduces the golden bit-exact (4096/4096) on these same operands.
